description: Inspect workspace OneLake settings, including lifecycle access-time tracking.
notes: lifecycle.accessTimeTracking reports whether file reads and writes update Azure Storage LastAccessTime. Change it with workspace modify-access-time-tracking --status Enabled|Disabled; metadata-only operations do not update the timestamp.

query_examples.description: Extract the effective access-time tracking status.

query_examples.query: lifecycle.{tier: defaultTier, policy: policy, accessTracking: accessTimeTracking}
